(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The method of claim 1 further comprising: __presenting__ the filtered EPG information.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: The method of claim 1 wherein filtering comprises: obtaining channel accessibility __information__ of the subscriber; and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility __information__ of the subscriber.

(Currently Amended) Claim 4: The method of claim 3 wherein obtaining comprises: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber from the content delivery provider; and creating a list of channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The method of claim 3 wherein removing comprises: reading the EPG information; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier __if the extracted channel identifier is not among__ the list of __channel identifiers accessible to the subscriber__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 8: The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data further comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: __presenting__ the filtered EPG information.

(Currently Amended) Claim 9: The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data causing the machine to perform filtering comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: obtaining channel accessibility __information__ of the subscriber; and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility __information__ of the subscriber.

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform obtaining comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber from the content delivery provider; and creating a list of channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform removing comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: reading the EPG information; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier __if the extracted channel identifier is not among__ the list of __channel identifiers accessible to the subscriber__.
